neighbours.label: ' anti' as a hyphenated prefix (anti-X: antibody targets, opposition movements)
fire: Several groups joined the anti-nuclear march in the capital.
The lab used an anti-GFP antibody to stain the cells.
Critics called the new law openly anti-immigrant.
He became a leading voice of the anti-slavery movement.
Doctors prescribed an anti-nausea medicine before surgery.
The town saw an anti-government rally on Saturday.
The blood test looks for anti-thyroid antibodies.
She wrote a book about anti-colonial resistance in Kenya.

notes: English top examples are ' anti' before a hyphen (anti-Scl, anti-Rh, anti-Black, anti-abortion); Chinese top examples are relational prepositions 有关/对/驻, not tested here. Probe: anti-war 0.38, anti-inflammatory 0.19, pro- 0.06.
